hypothesis: THIS IS A SCHEMA EXAMPLE, NOT A STRATEGY ATTEMPT. It exists so the pre-registration schema has one committed, machine-validated reference instance (python/tests/test_preregistration.py loads and validates every file in this directory). Its nominal, deliberately uninteresting falsifiable claim: a two-candidate SMA-crossover grid evaluated over the 1h research window produces a mean annualized fold Sharpe whose Deflated Sharpe Ratio, against the project-level selection-trial count, reaches 0.95. It will not, and nothing here expects it to -- research/strategies/ma_crossover.py's own module docstring states it is a pipeline-validation vehicle that must never be promoted toward paper or live trading.

.planning/sr-r-retrospective-closeout.md -- why the 1h research window is closed to selection, and why an infrastructure run on it is still permitted.
CLAUDE.md, 'Backtest/Walk-Forward Eligibility Bar' (amended and human-approved 2026-07-29) -- the criteria this registration restates.

per-fold max drawdown and profit factor

declared_power.derivation: One-sided, alpha=0.05: power = Phi(sqrt(years)*SR_true - Phi^-1(1-alpha)). years = 16078 bars / 24 bars-per-day / 365 = 1.83539; Phi(sqrt(1.83539)*0.8 - 1.6448536) = Phi(-0.56104) = 0.2874. So even a real 0.8 annualized Sharpe -- around the top of what credible institutional trend-following reports -- would be detected on this window only about 29% of the time. That number is the whole reason CLAUDE.md now closes this window to selection, and writing it down BEFORE a run is what none of the 117 prior trials did.

outcome_interpretation.PASS: DSR >= 0.95 at the project-level N, with the fold-consistency, sign-test, drawdown, trade-count and profit-factor criteria above all cleared. For THIS registration that outcome would mean the harness is miscomputing something, not that a placeholder SMA crossover has an edge -- investigate the measurement before believing the result.
outcome_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: Fewer than 30 closed trades across all folds (the frequency-scaled floor for this geometry), or the run otherwise cannot settle the question. Reported as INCONCLUSIVE-DATA-LIMITED: neither a pass nor a fail, and explicitly not evidence against the strategy.
outcome_interpretation.FAIL: The criterion is not cleared. Given the declared detection floor of 1.2141 annualized Sharpe and 28.7% power against a real 0.8 edge, this outcome means NOT SHOWN -- it does not mean shown absent. Report it as REJECTED-UNDERPOWERED (positive point estimate) or REJECTED (non-positive point estimate) per research/retrospective.py's vocabulary, always alongside the detection floor.

stopping_rule: One run of the two enumerated candidates. No candidate may be added, removed or re-valued after this file is committed: a changed grid is a NEW registration with a new preregistration_id, and the change is visible in git log and in the preregistration_sha256 recorded on every affected run. This registration is a schema example and has never been run; if it ever is, it is an INFRASTRUCTURE run under research/lineage.py's 'infrastructure' family (purpose=infrastructure, so it cannot inflate the research N), which CLAUDE.md's standing rule on the spent 1h window explicitly still permits: 'This window remains valid for reproducing a previously logged result, for diagnosing a mechanism, and for infrastructure testing -- none of which select a configuration.'
rationale: SCHEMA EXAMPLE. Committed by Strategy Research Task S (.planning/sr-s-preregistration.md) so that (a) configs/research/preregistrations/ exists as a git-tracked directory, (b) the schema has exactly one reference instance a future author can copy, and (c) python/tests/test_preregistration.py can assert that every committed registration in this directory validates -- a real regression guard on the schema, not documentation prose. It is deliberately NOT the pre-registration for the upcoming 1d attempt: CLAUDE.md reserves that window until its own specification is committed, which is a later task, and writing a placeholder for it here would either spend the reservation or leave a misleading file for a future reader to mistake for the real thing. Every number in this file is real and self-consistent (16,078 bars = the 1h research window from 2024-04-27T10:00:00Z to configs/research/holdout_1h.json's cutoff; 19 folds at train=2160/validate=720/step=720; 13,680 evaluated bars => a frequency-scaled trade floor of exactly 30, reproducing CLAUDE.md's own published table row), so the example cannot teach a future author a wrong shape.
notes: Every value under primary_criterion restates a human-approved Eligibility Bar constant. research/preregistration.py rejects any registration that restates one LAXER than approved, and accepts stricter -- see that module's docstring for why that is conformance checking rather than an opinion about the research.
